jobs.occupation: Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
**Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation

Who We Are

**NNIT is a niche specialist in IT for life sciences and highly regulated industries. We help pharma, biotech and medtech companies across Europe, the US and Asia, as well as public sector and regulated customers in Denmark, solve their most complex challenges where technology, regulation and business critical processes meet.

We are in the middle of a fundamental transformation. Our strategy, OneNNIT 2030, sets out how we will sharpen our position as a niche specialist, reshape our portfolio into a focused set of value pathways that take customers from advisory through implementation to managed services, bring our US and European organisations together as one, and become a genuinely AI-driven company.

The Strategy & Transformation Office leads that journey. It reports directly to our CEO, owns NNIT's strategy cycle, runs the transformation programme and builds the capabilities that will carry the momentum through to 2030. We are now building the team, and we are looking for a Data Science Student who wants to work at the heart of it.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of the analytical engine in the Strategy & Transformation Office. Every major decision in our transformation needs a solid fact base, and every initiative needs to show that it delivers. You will help build both, and your work will land directly with our CEO and Executive Management.

You are comfortable with code and data, and just as interested in what the numbers mean for the business. You are AI savvy, and you are curious about the bigger picture of how AI transforms organisations, ways of working and business models.

**Typical tasks include

**▪ Building the fact base behind OneNNIT 2030, from portfolio and revenue analysis to customer, market and capability data

▪ Designing and maintaining the KPIs, dashboards and benefit tracking that show Executive Management and the Board how the transformation is progressing

▪ Modelling revenue, margin and demand across offerings and geographies as we consolidate our portfolio into value pathways

▪ Combining data from finance, sales, delivery and HR systems into analyses that inform strategic decisions

▪ Identifying, sizing and prioritising AI use cases across our offerings, delivery model and internal processes, and tracking AI adoption across NNIT

▪ Building prototypes and analytical tools in Python, SQL or Power BI, and using generative AI to work faster and smarter

▪ Turning analysis into clear insights and material for workshops, leadership meetings and strategy sessions

**What You Will Bring

****We imagine that you

**▪ Are preferably in the third year of your Bachelor's degree, or in the first year of your Master’s degree, for example in Business ▪ Administration and Data Science or Digital Management at Copenhagen Business School

▪ Have a strong interest in data science, AI, strategy and business transformation

▪ Are curious about how data and AI change decisions, organisations and value creation

▪ Are analytical and structured, and able to turn complex data into clear insights that non-specialists can act on

▪ Have hands-on experience with Python and SQL, and with Power BI or a similar tool, alongside strong Excel and PowerPoint skills

▪ Communicate clearly and professionally in Danish and English, both written and spoken

▪ Take initiative, have a strong eye for quality, handle confidential information with discretion and enjoy working with senior stakeholders

**What We Offer

**You will join the Strategy & Transformation Office, which reports directly to the CEO, and work closely with the Head of Strategy & Transformation. You will have a front-row seat as NNIT redefines its strategy, organisation and portfolio, and you will work alongside Executive Management, senior leaders across Europe, the US and Asia, and our external advisors.

You will get real responsibility from day one, high exposure to senior leadership and the flexibility to balance work with your studies. Few student jobs offer a closer view of how strategy and transformation are done in practice.

**Practical Information

**The role is 15 to 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Please upload your CV and cover letter in English. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.

**About NNIT

**NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are. We invite interested candidates to apply, no matter their background.

In the interest of fostering a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request candidates to refrain from including their pictures in their applications.

Learn more about working at NNIT

Apply now and liberate your talent!

jobs.occupation: Student employee for Commercial Asset Management, Italy
jobs.description:
You’ll gain hands-on experience and insight into the energy markets that go beyond what you learn in the classroom. Along the way, you’ll help create solutions that enable our customers to grow their businesses.

Here’s what the job entails

As our new Junior Commercial Asset Manager, you will support our Commercial Asset Management and Origination teams, with a particular focus on Italian customers within renewables assets. You will contribute to a variety of commercial activities while gaining hands-on experience with the European energy markets. A key part of the role is also to engage with stakeholders, build relations and navigate across the entire organisation.

Furthermore, your responsibilities include:

• handling contract management and preparing tender and sales material

• joining customer meetings and contributing to solutions that support customer growth

• supporting planning, execution, and participation of commercial events, conferences and fairs

• collaborating closely with middle and back-office teams

• driving and participating in internal projects

The position is based in Copenhagen, alternatively Aarhus.

Meet your team

You will join our Commercial Asset Management team, dedicated to optimising Danske Commodities’ customer-related activities in Europe. The team collaborates closely with our Origination sales team to grow our customer business by for instance drafting contracts, managing tender processes and driving business development.

We share a deep understanding of energy markets and what our customers need. We keep an informal tone, and we believe teamwork is key to success. As a diverse team of market specialists across various European offices, nationalities and backgrounds, we bring together different perspectives to create real impact.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will work on a variety of tasks and collaborate with different people across the organisation, we imagine that you are curious, structured and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You enjoy working with others and find energy in supporting customers and colleagues.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• are enrolled in a relevant education within Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Energy Economics or similar

• are curious about energy markets and motivated to learn more

• can work approximately 15-20 hours a week

• are proficient in Italian and English – both written and spoken. If you speak any additional languages, we would love to hear about them

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life to fit with your studies

Unlimited paid child’s sick days because family comes first

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

Worklinq is looking for an energetic and results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition and accelerate our growth in the HR tech B2B SaaS market. In this role, you will be at the forefront of expanding our market presence, managing end-to-end sales processes from qualified opportunities through to closed contracts, and building strong relationships with enterprise decision-makers. You will work closely with multiple internal functions, including marketing, sales development and delivery, to turn commercial opportunities into long-term customers.

Key responsibilities

• End-to-end sales: Drive deals through the full cycle, from qualified meetings and solution demonstrations to final negotiation and signing.

• Modern sales execution: Use modern sales and AI tools to streamline prospect research, elevate message quality, and shorten sales cycles.

• Pipeline creation: Prospect into target enterprise accounts via outbound outreach, supplemented by handling qualified inbound leads.

• Commercial collaboration: Partner with marketing and delivery teams to ensure strong lead conversion and seamless handovers to customer onboarding.

• Pipeline hygiene & forecasting: Maintain structured CRM data, clear next steps, and realistic revenue forecasting for all active opportunities.

Professional qualifications

• Tool & AI fluency: Experience with structured CRM workflows and an active, competent approach to using AI tools for day-to-day productivity and research.

• Track record in B2B SaaS: Experience running and closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles.

• Consultative selling: Ability to navigate enterprise buying committees, uncover business pain points, and articulate software value.

• Contract & negotiation skills: Hands-on experience structuring commercial proposals and negotiating contracts with decision-makers.

Personal qualifications

• High drive & grit, motivated by target achievement, disciplined, and resilient through longer sales cycles.

• Strong communicator, capable of establishing trust, active listening, and clear communication with executive stakeholders.

• Proactive mindset with a high sense of ownership over your own pipeline and results.

• Curious & collaborative, quick to grasp complex industry workflows and eager to contribute to team learning.

• Enjoys working across teams, bringing together diverse expertise, including professional services, to create momentum and drive successful outcomes throughout the customer journey.

What we offer

Worklinq is in the midst of an exciting transformation, taking our Workforce Management platform forward as a modern cloud-based SaaS solution for large enterprises across the Nordics and Europe.

To succeed on this journey, we build our culture around four core values: Customer-centric, United, Transparent, and Innovative, which guide how we treat each other, our customers, and our partners every day.

From our headquarters in Denmark, you will work closely with colleagues in Sweden, Norway, the UK, and Romania. We have an informal tone, flat decision-making structures, and a collaborative team spirit. We know that strong results begin with people who thrive and grow. That is why we prioritise professional knowledge-sharing, a strong sense of community, and social gatherings both locally and across borders once or twice a year.

Ready to make an impact?

In this role, you will be part of a five-person Sales and Marketing team, reporting directly to the CCO.

Curious about the role, our culture, or how we hire? We’d love to chat. Reach out to Head of People & Culture Anne Heiberg, ah@worklinq.com.

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• 
Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• 
Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• 
Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• 
Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• 
Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• 
Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• 
Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• 
Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• 
Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• 
Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• 
Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• 
Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• 
Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• 
Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• 
Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• 
Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 
2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• 
A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• 
Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• 
A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• 
Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• 
Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• 
Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• 
Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• 
Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• 
Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• 
Competitive salary + company paid pension

• 
Private health insurance

• 
Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• 
Lunch subsidized by the company

• 
DSB Business Card

• 
Company phone and company credit card

• 
Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• 
Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• 
Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• 
Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• 
Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• 
Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• 
Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

Sparrow Quantum is seeking a student assistant with a data science background to support our business functions with automation and data management

• 
Type: Part-time student position

• 
Hours: 10 to 15 hours per week, planned around your studies

• 
Compensation: Hourly wage according to qualifications

• 
Location: Frederiksberg

• 
Start date: February 1 (flexible)

• 
Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Do you want to apply your data science skills to real business problems in a deep-tech scale-up?

As Sparrow Quantum grows, so does the data behind the business: customer and supplier records, orders, finance figures, and hiring data spread across spreadsheets and systems. We are looking for a student assistant to bring order to that data and automate the work around it, in close collaboration with finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing.

To be clear about the scope: this is applied data work for business functions, not machine learning research. Your hours will be split evenly between data management and automation on one side, and business support across the company on the other.

Responsibilities

Data management

• 
Clean and maintain business data across finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing

• 
Support on developing data flows between our systems, so the same data is not entered twice

• 
Maintain data quality checks, naming conventions and documentation, and keep them up to date

• 
Support maintaining dashboards and reports that give management and teams an up-to-date view of key figures, in tools such as Power BI and Excel

Automation

• 
Support on mapping recurring manual processes and propose which to automate first

• 
Help build and maintain automations in Python or other tools, and with tools such as Microsoft 365

• 
Use AI tools, including large language models, to speed up data handling and reporting, within our rules for confidential information

• 
Document what you build so colleagues can run it when you are not there

Business support (about half your time)

• 
Support finance, operations, and HR with day-to-day tasks such as documentation, purchasing, invoicing, and supplier contact

• 
Take on ad hoc analyses and small projects wherever the business needs a hand

Who we are looking for

You enjoy turning messy data into something people can rely on, and you would rather fix a process than repeat it. You are curious about how a company works across functions, and you can explain your work to colleagues without a technical background.

You have

• 
Enrollment in a bachelor's or master's program in data science or a related field, with at least 1.5 years of study left

• 
Experience with Python for data work, including pandas or similar libraries

• 
Knowledge of SQL and relational data

• 
Experience cleaning, structuring, and visualizing real-world data

• 
Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, and a realistic view of where they fail

• 
A structured, reliable way of working

• 
Discretion with confidential information

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to have

• 
Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or other Microsoft 365 tools

• 
Experience with APIs or simple data pipelines

• 
Understanding basic accounting and financial data

• 
Curiosity about quantum technology. No physics background required

What we offer

• 
Flexibility: hours planned around lectures and exams, with lighter weeks when your studies require it

• 
Visible impact: the data flows, dashboards and automations you build will be used by the team every day, not filed away

• 
A view of the whole company: insight into how a deep-tech scale-up works across R&D, production, sales and finance

• 
A supportive team: colleagues who share knowledge freely and expect you to ask questions

• 
Shaping your role: it is a new role, and you can help shape it

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English. In the letter, describe one data or automation project you have worked on: the problem, what you built and what it changed. A GitHub link or a few sentences is enough.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is 1st December. For questions about the role, contact Anna Sogli, agd@sparrowquantum.com.

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

DPM GE Business support

Drug Product Manufacturing IO

Global Manufacturing & Supply

**Your impact begins here

**As Finance Partner, you will turn financial insight into better decisions across Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) in Gentofte. You will partner with directors and the management group on planning, performance and strategy deployment. You will bring transparency to the numbers, strengthen finance processes and help the site keep unit cost low, both now and in the long term. Your analysis will help production teams make clear, well-founded choices.

**What You'll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, International Business or similar.

• 3–4 years of experience in finance partnering and controlling, such as financial planning and analysis, business controlling or auditing.

• Experience navigating complex organisational structures in a large company, with excellent stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to drive agendas independently.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to see the big picture and focus on detail when needed.

• High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

• Full professional proficiency in English.

You are driven by analyzing data and solving financial challenges. You take responsibility whatever the complexity, and you keep a strong focus on quality and structure. You build strong relationships at all levels and explain complex issues clearly.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience in pharmaceutical production or production economy.

• Knowledge of SAP or another major ERP system.

• Business intelligence (BI) skills.

**What You'll Do

**You will work with the management group on financial planning and analysis, performance management and business strategy deployment. You will:

• Act as finance partner to key stakeholders, including directors, at the DPM site in Gentofte.

• Drive financial processes, including budget, rolling estimate and month-end reporting.

• Give financial guidance to the organization and help develop the processes and tools that improve financial transparency.

• Analyze data and create insights that support management decisions, such as business cases and strategic finance analysis.

• Prepare management presentations, along with ad hoc analyses and tasks.

• Work with the management team and the finance community to continuously improve finance processes and bridge finance and the business across DPM Gentofte.

**Who You'll Work With

**In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain, from drug and device development to marketed Novo products. They scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them. More than 30,000 colleagues around the world share this responsibility.

You will join the Business Support department at DPM Site Gentofte, which enables operational success through close collaboration and strong cross-functional partnerships. You will be part of the Finance, Investment and Procurement team. It manages all finance partnering and procurement activities at the site. This includes driving process excellence, allocating resources well, and delivering insights and actions based on available data.

You will join a diverse team of 8–10 colleagues with different levels of business experience. Together, you will spot gaps and propose high-quality improvements to processes and the organisation. Your closest partners will be the management group and directors at DPM Gentofte, together with the wider finance community.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an ambitious team that aims to deliver the best possible service to the production departments. You will get plenty of sparring and development feedback. You will have room to take ownership, build your skills and grow your impact. The team also makes sure to have fun while it drives the business forward.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Working at Novo Nordisk

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn financial insight into progress for the production teams in Gentofte, apply by 22 November 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about your motivation to apply in your CV.

Please apply in English and refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing. We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants. Note that we use screening questions as part of the application process for this position; however, all CVs are reviewed by a recruiter. We encourage you to answer these carefully, as they help us assess your expectations, experience and qualifications.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Interest Rate Option Trader – Graduate / Early Career
jobs.description:
Interest rate markets move constantly, and the people who understand them shape how risk is managed for clients across the region. Joining our Derivatives Trading team you will be working directly with experienced traders and building practical expertise in interest-rate options from day one.

What you will be doing

You will be part of a close-knit trading team where analysis, precision, and curiosity matter every day. Working within Derivatives Trading, you will support the pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions, monitor market developments, and collaborate with colleagues across sales, quant, risk, and operations.

More specifically, you will:

· Support pricing and execution of interest rate option transactions under experienced traders

· Monitor interest rate markets, volatility, and economic developments with the team

· Analyse portfolio exposures and help manage risk within agreed limits

· Build and improve tools for pricing and risk monitoring using Python or similar languages

· Collaborate with sales, quant, risk, and operations colleagues to support accurate trade processing

About you

You are a recent graduate or have up to two years of relevant experience in trading, quantitative analysis, asset management or a related field. Previous trading experience is not required. We are interested in your analytical ability, curiosity and willingness to learn.

· Degree in economics with a technical focus, alternatively in mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related quantitative field

· Strong numerical and analytical skills with a structured approach to problem solving

· Genuine interest in fixed income markets and a desire to build a career in trading

· Programming ability in Python or a comparable language, applied to practical problems

· Fluency in English and a Scandinavian language

· Sound judgement, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and raise concerns

Familiarity with derivatives, probability, statistics, or numerical methods is an advantage, though no prior trading experience is required. Academic projects, relevant coursework, or internships are all useful ways to demonstrate your analytical interest.

What we offer you

This role offers structured learning through direct collaboration with experienced traders, with responsibility growing as your knowledge deepens. This is a full-time, in-office role with daily access to colleagues who are invested in your progress and development.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please get in touch with hiring manager Frederik Dimo-Ungermann at fd i@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Tribe Lead for Cards & Financing Platform tribe
jobs.description:
Our customers deserve banking that fits their lives, not the other way around. As Tribe Lead for the Cards & Financing Platform tribe, you will lead an organisation dedicated to enabling intuitive, embedded, and tailored offerings across cards and financing. This is a rare opportunity to lead at scale within a team that puts customers at the center of every decision.

Overview of Danske Bank

Danske Bank is a leading Nordic financial services group dedicated to strengthening its position in the market by delivering innovative, resilient, and sustainable core capabilities. The mission of the Cards & Financing Platform tribe focuses on enhancing customer experiences across all markets with offerings in mortgages, lending, cards, and branch services, including core financing capabilities supporting Realkredit Danmark, in close collaboration with sister tribes responsible for our customer-facing offerings.

We prioritise sustainability and have refined our organisational structure into focused tribes, each led by experts in their respective fields. The Cards & Financing Platform is a vital component, encompassing approximately 280 colleagues across more than 20 squads primarily located in Denmark, India and Lithuania, all committed to advancing our Forward '28 strategy.

What you will be doing

You will co-lead the Cards & Financing Platform tribe together with the Tribe Leadership Team, which includes an IT Lead, Tribe Coach, and Tribe Architect. All Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) will report to you, making your leadership central to how the tribe collaborates and delivers on the Danske Bank Forward '28 strategy.

More specifically, you will:

• Guide Product Owners and leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads) on roadmap priorities and tribe backlog

• Lead strategy, Annual Business Reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews across the tribe

• Engage senior stakeholders to align on priorities, dependencies, and major decisions

• Engage with large international vendors as part of the tribe's delivery commitments

• Act as HR manager for Product Owners, leaders for Business Analysts (Business Chapter Leads), Business Manager, and Management Coordinator

• Drive tribe performance across delivery, adoption, business outcomes, efficiency, and cost, working closely with commercial stakeholders to realise the value of existing and new solutions

• Drive the development and implementation of GenAI solutions and embed AI-enabled ways of working across the tribe to improve productivity, quality, and customer and business outcomes.

• Drive the tribe’s risk and compliance agenda and, together with the Tribe Leadership Team, advance platform modernisation while maintaining reliable end-to-end services.

About you

• Solid experience leading large, cross-functional technology or product organisations

• Background in cards, financing or daily banking, with a genuine interest in technology

• Ability to translate strategic direction into clear priorities and communicate them accessibly

• Track record of delivering solutions that improve customer experiences

• Skilled at building agile, collaborative cultures where colleagues feel trusted and supported

• Skilled at engaging with senior leaders and managing complex stakeholder relationships

• Open to continuous personal and professional development

What we offer you

You will join the organisation at an important moment, with real responsibility and genuine trust from the start. The role is hybrid, with three to four days per week in the office in Copenhagen to support collaboration and knowledge sharing across a geographically spread tribe. You will have room to develop your own skills while supporting your colleagues to do the same, within a team that values openness, belonging, and shared learning.

Are you ready for the next step?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager Mark Wraa-Hansen (mark.wraa.hansen@danskebank.dk) head of Personal Banking DK. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply at your earliest convenience or by 23.11.26 at the latest.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Consultant – Actuarial Services, Financial Services Advisory
jobs.description:
Are you an actuary with a couple of years of experience looking to broaden your career beyond a traditional actuarial role? Would you like to work across insurance, audit and advisory, helping some of the largest financial institutions solve complex actuarial and business challenges?

Then you might be our new colleague in KPMG’s Financial Services Advisory team in Copenhagen.

The opportunity

We are looking for an ambitious actuary with approximately 2 years of relevant professional experience to strengthen our actuarial capabilities within Financial Services Advisory.

You will join a multidisciplinary team working with insurance companies and other financial institutions. Your assignments will vary from supporting our audit teams on actuarial matters to advising clients directly on actuarial, risk, regulatory and transformation topics.

The role provides a strong opportunity to combine your actuarial expertise with broader business and advisory experience and to develop your career in an environment where you will work closely with experienced colleagues, clients and specialists across KPMG.

What you will be doing

Depending on your experience and interests, your work may include:

• Performing actuarial analyses of insurance liabilities and technical provisions.

• Supporting the audit of insurance companies, including review and challenge of actuarial assumptions, methodologies, models and calculations.

• Working with Solvency II, financial reporting and other regulatory requirements relevant to insurers.

• Reviewing and challenging reserving methodologies, models, assumptions and data.

• Supporting actuarial modelling, validation and quantitative analyses.

• Advising insurance clients on improvements to their actuarial processes, governance, controls and documentation.

• Contributing to projects at the intersection of actuarial science, risk management, regulation, data and technology.

• Working directly with clients and gradually taking responsibility for your own workstreams and deliverables.

• Collaborating with colleagues across KPMG in Denmark and our international network.

The aim is not only for you to apply your actuarial skills, but also to develop into a trusted adviser who understands both the numbers and the business behind them.

Who we are looking for

We expect that you:

• Hold a relevant quantitative degree, ideally within actuarial mathematics, insurance mathematics or a closely related field.

• Have approximately 2 years of relevant experience, for example from an insurance company, consultancy or audit firm.

• Have practical experience with actuarial calculations, models or insurance liabilities.

• Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with complex quantitative topics.

• Are interested in understanding the commercial, regulatory and strategic context surrounding actuarial work.

• Communicate clearly and are comfortable discussing your analyses with both specialists and non-specialists.

• Enjoy working collaboratively and taking responsibility.

• Are fluent in English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage.

Experience within life insurance, non-life insurance, pensions, reserving, Solvency II or actuarial audit would be particularly relevant, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all areas.

What we offer

At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to build a career that extends beyond a traditional actuarial role.

You will become part of Financial Services Advisory, where we bring together expertise across insurance, banking, risk, regulation, data, technology and transformation. You will work alongside experienced specialists while being given responsibility early in your career.

We offer:

• A steep learning curve and exposure to different insurance companies and business models.

• The opportunity to combine actuarial expertise with advisory and business skills.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior colleagues.

• Access to KPMG's Danish and international actuarial and financial-services network.

• Opportunities to work on projects beyond traditional actuarial assignments.

• A collaborative and informal environment with strong focus on professional and personal development.

Most importantly, we offer the opportunity to help shape and grow our actuarial capability in Financial Services Advisory.

Why KPMG?

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals driven by progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Interested?

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we are excited to get to know you better. Feel free to contact Senior Manager, Teis Dengsøe, tdengsoee@kpmg.com, or Partner Hans Jørgen Andresen, hansjandresen@kpmg.com. We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG

**About The Role

**At OrderYOYO, payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

****Role Mission

****Own and evolve OrderYOYO's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

****Core Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.

• Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.

• Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.

• Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.

• Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.

• Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.

• Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.

• Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.

• A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.

• Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.

• Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).

• Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK66,000/ month

• A role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the services you build.

• The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.

• A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Cell Bank Scientist, CMC Drug Development
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

Ready to bring together microbial science, GMP manufacturing and project responsibility in a senior role where your work directly supports the development of future medicines? Join our Microbial Cell Bank team, where every drug substance begins - we manufacture and maintain the cell banks that are the starting point for drug substance production all over the world. Working cross-functionally across projects, you will combine your scientific expertise with GMP responsibility and help drive continuous improvement of our Cell Bank operation. Ready to take the lead where every medicine begins? Apply today!

**What you’ll do

**As a Senior Scientist in the Microbial Cell Bank, you will take a leading professional role in activities related to the production and lifecycle management of our cell banks. You will take ownership of complex tasks and projects, working closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, QA, QC and project teams. With your experience, you will help navigate cross-functional processes, identify solutions and contribute to developing both our processes and ways of working. Depending on your experience and interests, the role provides an opportunity to build deeper expertise and potentially develop towards a specialist position.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Planning and supporting GMP manufacture of microbial Master Cell Banks (MCBs) and Working Cell Banks (WCBs).

• Taking project responsibility for cell bank projects from incoming Initial Cell Clone (ICC) through production, characterisation, release and lifecycle activities.

• Preparing and maintaining specifications, production documentation and other GMP documentation.

• Coordinating activities and solving issues across QA, QC, project teams and other key stakeholders.

• Handling deviations and change requests and driving systematic problem solving.

• Supporting regulatory activities, audits, inspections and responses to Health Authority questions.

• Driving continuous improvements to cell bank processes and ways of working.

• Contributing to the continued digitalisation of our Cell Bank operation and exploring how new technologies, including AI, can support smarter and more efficient ways of working.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you hold a relevant master’s degree within biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related scientific field. You also have:

• a solid background from the pharmaceutical industry and a strong understanding of GMP.

• hands-on skills in microbial cultivation and knowledge of microbiology, molecular biology, cellular biology and analytical science.

• a proven ability to navigate a complex organisation and work across functions.

• a strong quality mindset combined with an analytical and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• an interest in digitalisation and new technology. Experience with AI is an advantage, but curiosity and motivation to explore how AI can improve our work are equally important.

On a personal level, you are collaborative, curious and motivated by taking professional and independent ownership of activities and projects involving multiple stakeholders. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and contributing to the development of others while continuously strengthening your own expertise. You communicate effectively across functions and organisational levels and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when you see opportunities to improve.

Who you’ll work with

CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

Cell Banks are at the starting point of drug substance production and play an important role in bringing new medicines through CMC Drug Development. We are a team of approximately 16 scientists and laboratory technicians working with microbial cell banks in Bagsværd and mammalian cell banks in Hillerød, with an ambition to collaborate closely and share knowledge across the two locations.

We have a strong focus on quality, collaboration and delivering for our projects. At the same time, we are ambitious about developing the Cell Bank area and continuously improving our processes, facilities and digital ways of working. We value an open and collaborative environment where we help each other, share knowledge and believe that having fun at work is an important part of being a strong team.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Please apply by 22 November 2026.

**

Due to the short deadline, please apply as soon as possible. We review CVs and invite candidates to interview on an ongoing basis.**

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Associate Director Jesper Roland Jørgensen at +45 30797885.

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to submit a cover letter explaining why you are the ideal candidate to join us in the Cell Bank team. Please do not include a photo in your CV, as this supports a fair and efficient recruitment process.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

Your impact begins here

Turn financial data into insights and support for decisions that help build future manufacturing capacity for patients worldwide. As Finance Partner in Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) Expansions, you will be part of strengthening cost transparency and financial reporting, combined with improving forecasts and helping secure right resource planning across a multi-billion DKK investment portfolio. Your insights will support across the Global Project Management Office (GPMO) and selected expansion sites. You will combine independent ownership with close collaboration in an experienced finance team. Key is that you are ready for a step learning curve and take ownership in your work and bring high energy and motivation to make a difference within delivering sound financial management.

What you'll bring

You can translate complex financial information into clear business insights and recommendations and build trusted relationships with stakeholders from expansion sites to the finance community. For this role, the essentials are:

• A master’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration or a related discipline.

• Relevant experience in financial planning and analysis, business finance, controlling or business partnering, including independent delivery of reporting and analysis.

• Strong understanding of financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, with close attention to data quality.

• Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain findings simply and build a compelling financial story.

Key tasks:

Your job as steel fitter will be responsible for assembling, positioning, aligning, and fitting structural steel components to create frameworks for buildings, bridges, ships, and heavy machinery.

 Your key responsibilities & duties will include:

·         Blueprint Interpretation: Study engineering drawings, blueprints, and material lists to plan the sequence of tasks and determine material requirements.

·         Layout and Fabrication: Layout reference points and patterns on heavy metal to prepare for cutting, bending, and forming.

·         Assembly and Fitting: Assemble, align, and fit metal sections and plates to form complete units or subunits, using tack welding, bolting, or riveting.

·         Machine Operation: Operate heavy-duty machinery such as cranes, shearers, brake presses, grinders, drills, and cutting torches to prepare components.

·         Quality Inspection: Inspect and test completed components to ensure they meet specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations.

·         Positioning and Installation: Position parts in jigs (sometimes created by tack-welding scrap metal) and use grinders, chisels, or files to ensure precise fits.
